item.title: AI Therapists May Be Doing More Harm Than Good, Study Warns
item.description: Study finds AI therapists may reinforce harmful beliefs, show bias, and fail in crises, raising serious mental health concerns.

item.title: Innovative New Design Helps Superconductors Withstand Heat and Magnetic Fields
item.description: Researchers at Chalmers University of Technology shaped the surface where superconducting material is grown, improving its performance at higher temperatures, and preserving its stability in strong magnetic fields.

item.title: Ancient "Machine Gun" May Have Been Used in Pompeii Siege, Study Finds
item.description: New study suggests Pompeii siege damage may reveal use of an ancient rapid-fire weapon, reshaping views of Roman warfare.

item.title: A Mysterious Ancient Egyptian Text Reveals Evidence of Advanced Medicine 1000 Years Earlier Than Once Thought
item.description: An obscure ancient Egyptian text discovered in the 19th century led to discoveries that rewrote the timeline of early medical knowledge.

item.title: “We Want to Understand How We Got Here": Extragalactic Archaeology is Helping Astronomers Reveal a Spiral Galaxy’s Hidden Past
item.description: Extragalactic archaeology has come of age, with astronomers for the first time reconstructing the history of a spiral galaxy.

item.title: Coffee and Tea Linked to Lower Dementia Risk Over Decades of Tracking
item.description: A long-term study led by researchers from Mass General Brigham found that moderate consumption of caffeinated coffee or tea was associated with a lower risk of dementia and improved cognitive performance in participants over time.

item.title: The “Secrecy Paradox”: New Study Reveals the Hidden Social Game Behind “Insider Knowledge”
item.description: New study reveals how the Secrecy Paradox shapes status, spreads secrets, and drives hidden hierarchies in online communities.

item.title: “You Can Create and Control This Exotic State Using Light “: DARPA-Funded Scientists Use Lasers to Create a New Exotic State of Matter at Room Temperature
item.description: Researchers using custom fabricated nanostructures that 'trap' light have created a new exotic state of matter with light at room temperature

item.title: Evidence of Advanced Medicine in Egypt's Old Kingdom, Lucid Dreaming Science, and Earth's 2-Billion-Year-Old Nuclear Reactor
item.description: This week, ancient advanced medical knowledge in Egypt's Old Kingdom and new research revealing a surprising link between perception and lucid dreaming are covered in recent stories from The Debrief.

item.title: Bronze Age Artifact Made from ‘Space Metal’ Unearthed at a Sacrificial Site is Confirmed as the Oldest of Its Kind
item.description: A curious Bronze Age artifact unearthed at a ceremonial site in southwestern China has now been identified as the earliest known and the largest of its kind, according to newly published research.
